name: Kakei Juuzou
source:
Former retainer of the Sanada clan. Attendant to Nobushige Sanada.

Juzo originally served Nobushige as a page within the Sanada household, then followed him to Mt. Kudo even after their confinement. He later began working as a Sanada ninja, specializing in modified firearms, explosives, and gunpowder handling. Because of a debt of gratitude to the Sanada family, he always puts Nobushige first. He makes sound, rational judgments and treats women kindly.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/homura/chara/?page=jyuzou]Idea Factory International[/url]]
